turns.text: Hi, welcome! What answer did you get for the problem?
Okay, thanks. Can you walk me through how you got 36?
Well, 15 cups times 50 cents is 7.50, and then times 4 hours is 30. Then 10 cups times 60 cents is 6, and I added 30 and 6.
Your 30 covers four hours. How many hours does your 6 cover?
Um, the next hours at the new price... oh, it's only one hour of it. But it was two hours.
What would you do to your 6 to fix that?
Good. So what are your two parts now, and what do they make together?
Nice work. Why do you multiply by the number of hours for each part?
Because he sells the same amount every hour, so the money for one hour times how many hours gives the whole part.
